answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the basalt of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the garden until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lantern of the next round.
